rows.ARS: Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin:
Bred by Frank C. Raffel (United States, 1962).
Introduced in United States by Port Stockton Nursery in circa 1963 as 'Mauve Melodee'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve - pink. Moderate fragrance. 25 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Decorative, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Dark green, leathery foliage.

Height: up to 5' (up to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Sterling Silver (hybrid tea, Fisher 1955) ×
Unnamed Seedling
